text:
maya: noticed a weird mismatch in the latency dashboard. p99 on the top-level endpoint view jumped 400ms at ~10:15 but the endpoint breakdown shows nothing near that for any single backend.
aj: hm, did the sampling change? We recently toggled route-level sampling for rollout traces.
sanjay: could also be a rollup artifact. We merge t-digests from shards; if one shard is tiny it can skew tails when merged incorrectly.
lucas: confirmed the UI rollup uses the 'global' aggregator by default. per-endpoint view uses per-shard histograms that then get weighted. different code paths.
emily: this caused product to flag an SLA breach in the console demo. we need clear guidance + quick fix. do we prefer changing UI or the aggregation semantics?
maya: short-term: add a tooltip clarifying sampling + rollup mode. long-term: prefer consistent aggregation so top-level equals weighted merge of endpoints.
joe: (zoe) small nit: the heatmap shows p50/p95/p99 but the labels don't say whether they're from merged tdigest or exact counts.
aj: we can push a hotfix: expose the rollup mode in the API response: `rollup_mode: "approx_merge" vs "weighted_exact"` and show badge in dashboard.
sanjay: engineering note: switching to weighted_exact everywhere is expensive CPU-wise. we should make it opt-in and add a background job to rehydrate high-cardinality routes for accurate tails.
lucas: suggestion: default overview -> p95 to avoid noisy p99 alerts, keep p99 in detailed endpoint panels with a warning about sample bias.
emily: agreed. customers usually care about p95 for SLOs, p99 useful for debug only.
maya: QA: who owns the metrics schema change? we need a tiny API bump + console label + one-line docs.
aj: i'll own the API flag. maya can do the console label + tooltip. sanjay + infra to prototype rehydration job.
zoe: I'll add a short blurb to the runbook and update the internal incident playbook for 'apparent SLA spikes from rollup mismatch'.
deploy-bot: deploy start: api-service v2.14.3 -> infra-stage; ETA 6m
aj: quick query to debug: `select pct(99, latency) from tdigest_merge(samples) by route where time > now() - 1h` — if that diverges from `pct(99, latency) by shard` then we have a merge skew.
maya: thanks. i'll add an entry in the rollout checklist to watch top-level vs per-endpoint delta > 100ms as a canary.
emily: product follow-up: schedule a short customer note explaining dashboard semantics once we have the UI badge + docs.
aj: timeline: badge + tooltip today, API flag tomorrow, rehydration prototype next week. sound good?
sanjay: y
lucas: y
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
